conceptZh: 披風英雄想說謝謝，披風太長絆倒，一路撞倒排好的積木，倒下的積木剛好拼成「你」。
object: a caped action-figure hero with a cape three sizes too long, and a long row of standing wooden dominoes in cobalt blue
morph: a tumbling row of cobalt domino blocks lands in the strokes of the glyph 你
creativeAngle: 骨牌效應：披風英雄被自己的披風絆倒，推倒一排骨牌，運氣好地倒成「你」；詞用「謝謝你」鞠躬送禮。
promptEn: An 8-second slapstick cartoon clip on a clean solid pale peach backdrop. The only text in frame is one large Traditional Chinese glyph 你, formed from chunky cobalt-blue domino blocks and tiles, about 70% of frame height, centered with margins. Lead: a caped action-figure hero with a red cape three sizes too long that keeps flopping over his own head; one supporting object, a small gift box tied with yellow ribbon. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Voice: warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin saying exactly 你、你、謝謝你 (ㄋㄧˇ、ㄋㄧˇ、ㄒㄧㄝˋ ㄒㄧㄝ˙ ㄋㄧˇ); the repeated 謝謝 uses the neutral tone on the second syllable; slow, clear tones, then stop. Moment 1 (0–1.8s): the hero strides in with a heroic pose, cape trailing across the floor, and as the first 你 is spoken he flicks the first standing blue domino with one finger, setting off a clack-clack chain. Moment 2 (1.8–3.6s): the cape swings up and swallows his head; blindly he wobbles in circles, his boots sliding, while the domino row snakes through the frame behind him, curving left, curling around a bend. Moment 3 (3.6–5s): on the second 你 the cape tangles his feet and he topples forward, flopping onto the last domino, which clicks into place; the whole chain tumbles in a rolling wave and settles exactly into the shape of 你, a slim slanting person-stroke on the left and a tall right part with a slanted top, a horizontal bar, and a hooked vertical with two short dashes. Moment 4 (5s): as 謝謝你 is spoken, he squirms out of the cape, bows twice, and hands over the ribbon gift box toward the glyph, a tiny star-shaped confetti puff leaping from the box. Final 5–8s: the glyph 你 stays rock still and fully readable, tiles all flat and unmoving, while the hero beside it wiggles, cape in a cheerful flutter, rocking happily on his heels without touching any tile. Gentle daylight, no flashing, no real people, no other text.

conceptZh: 調皮小老鼠想吃門後的大起司，助跑衝鋒撞門「咚」一聲，門上鬆掉的紅木板掉下來剛好排成「你」；拉布拉多警長衝進來卻滑過頭，反而把起司撞出來，小老鼠抱著起司向警長鞠躬說謝謝你。
object: a tall plank door built from loose tomato-red wooden planks and pegs, a giant cheese wedge behind it, and a cheeky cartoon mouse charging at it
morph: the BONK of the charge shakes the red planks and pegs off the door; they tumble down and land as the strokes of 你: two slanting planks as the left person radical, and on the right a short slant, a flat capped bar with a hook, a hooked vertical peg and two short pegs flanking it
creativeAngle: 前一版是披風英雄絆倒推骨牌，這版改成完全不同的「衝鋒撞門」實體笑料：目標（起司）、助跑、撞擊、暈眩全都看得見，撞落的木板本身就變成筆畫。警長只負責一個笑點：衝進來維持秩序卻滑過頭，順勢把起司撞出門，讓「謝謝你」有具體的鞠躬對象。字形筆畫用亮紅木板對淺薄荷底色，筆畫結構逐一指定，不犧牲正確性。
promptEn:
An 8-second slapstick cartoon clip on a clean, solid pale mint backdrop with soft even daylight, nothing busy behind. The only text ever in frame is one large, correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 你, built from chunky tomato-red wooden planks and pegs, filling about 70% of frame height, centered with clear margins. Lead: an original tiny cheeky cartoon mouse, grey-blue fur, enormous round pink ears, a permanent sly grin, lightning fast. One supporting character: an original big friendly cartoon Labrador sheriff dog with a gold star badge and a whistle. One prop set: a tall door made of loose red planks standing at frame right, with a giant yellow cheese wedge visible peeking over the top behind it. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no real people.

Voice: a warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 你、你、謝謝你 (ㄋㄧˇ、ㄋㄧˇ、ㄒㄧㄝˋ ㄒㄧㄝ˙ ㄋㄧˇ), reading exactly those syllables, slowly and distinctly with clear tones, with a short pause between the two single characters, and then stops.

Moment 1, want it (0–1.5s): the mouse zips in from frame left, screeches to a halt, and spots the cheese wedge gleaming over the top of the red plank door. Its eyes go huge, it points one paw straight at the cheese, licks its lips, and digs both back feet into the ground. The first 你 is spoken right as it points.

Moment 2, try and miss (1.5–3s): the mouse darts at a small round mouse-hole in the bottom of the door, but a cork plugs it; the mouse boings off the cork like a rubber ball, spins twice in midair and lands on its ears. From frame right the Labrador sheriff gallops in blowing the whistle to keep order, skids on stiff legs straight past the mouse and off the left edge of frame with a comic scrape.

Moment 3, the big crash (3–5s): the mouse scrambles back to frame left, leans way back in an exaggerated wind-up, little legs pedaling in a blur, then charges at full speed across the whole frame and hits the door with a big squashy BONK, squashed flat against it like a pancake. The door shudders, and its red planks and pegs rattle loose and tumble down one after another, landing flat and neat as the glyph 你: two slanting planks on the left forming the standing-person radical, and on the right a short slanted plank up top, a flat capped bar with a small hook on its right end, a long hooked vertical peg hanging from the center of the cap, and two short pegs flanking it low on either side. The second 你 is spoken exactly as the last peg clicks into place. The mouse peels off the doorframe and staggers out flattened, with a dizzy, delighted grin and little stars circling its ears.

Moment 4, payoff (5–8s): the glyph 你 stays perfectly still, flat and fully readable for the whole final 3 seconds, with nobody touching it. The sheriff peeks back in from frame left, dusty and sheepish, and in doing so his tail bumps the open doorframe at far right; the giant cheese wedge topples out and lands in the mouse's arms. As 謝謝你 is spoken, the mouse hugs the cheese, bows twice toward the sheriff with paws pressed together in thanks, and the sheriff tips his badge back. The mouse then wobbles on dizzy legs beside the glyph, nibbling the cheese happily, staying clear of every stroke until the end. Bright but not neon colors, no pure white blowouts, no flashing effects, no other text or watermark.
